title: Introduction
summary: Introduction to the mdBook tutorial that builds the Warren roguelike in six runnable steps, stating the engine's two API rules and the prerequisites.
notes: Output filename uses a path-derived suffix instead of a SHA-256 prefix because no hashing tool was available, matching sibling classifier outputs. Content restates design rules ('own the loop or leave it out', 'engine never names your content') but as tutorial prose, not decisions or requirements.
